title: ChatDaemon protocol v1
description: Generated from @conet.project/chat-sdk src/protocol.ts by scripts/genDaemonSchema.ts. Do not edit by hand. A message is either a ChatDaemonCommand (page → daemon) or a ChatDaemonOutbound (daemon → page).

error.description: Short code, never key material or plaintext (e.g. `unknown_command`, `bad_identity`).

armorHash.description: Single-hash form accepted by native daemons.

AckInboundCommand.description: The page stored these inbound messages (capability `inbound.deferAck`): send the mailbox ACK and the sender receipt now.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Own mailbox B: `gossip_delivery_ack` (own wallet + armor hash). Sender: a `beamio_chat_delivery_receipt_v1` sent like `send` with NoPush (receipt and our signature only inside the sender's user-PGP layer).

protocolVersion.description: Newest protocol version the daemon speaks.

minProtocolVersion.description: Oldest protocol version the daemon still speaks (default: `protocolVersion`).

eoaAddress.description: EOA address (checksummed or lower — SDK normalises).

privateKeyHex.description: Raw ethers private key hex (with or without 0x). Used inside the worker to build an `ethers.Wallet` for EIP-191 signing and to derive the history master secret. Consumer/POS may inject a persisted key; bizSite injects a session-memory-only key. The SDK holds it only in the worker's memory.

pgpPrivateKeyArmored.description: Armored PGP private key for this identity's chat route (decrypts inbound).

pgpPassphrase.description: Passphrase for the armored PGP private key, if any.

pgpPublicKeyArmored.description: Armored PGP public key (for regiestChatRoute / diagnostics).

ownRouteArmoredPublicKey.description: This identity's own mailbox route armored public key (mailbox B).

ChatIdentity.description: Signing material + capabilities the host injects. The SDK never persists private keys itself.

userPublicKeyArmored.description: Recipient's user PGP public key — business payloads are encrypted to this.

routerArmoredPublicKey.description: Recipient mailbox B route armored public key — listen/ACK/mailbox work are encrypted to this.

ChatRoute.description: Per-contact chat route metadata resolved from AddressPGP.

ClearIdentityCommand.description: Logout / wallet switch / wallet removal: stop, forget keys, inbox store and session. Answer: `ack { ok }`.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing. Local wipe of keys, inbox store and session.

walletSignature.description: Wallet signature paths this command can produce (empty = none).

viaEntry.description: `true`: POST through entry nodes (never directly to a mailbox). `false`: no CoNET node traffic.

nodeSees.description: What CoNET nodes (entry, mailbox) and other services can read in plaintext.

gap.description: Open item or known exception, if any.

DestroyCommand.description: End this page session. Native keeps the stored identity (use `clearIdentity` to forget it).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing (the listen closes).

memberEoas.description: Other members. The worker adds the signing owner.

routes.description: Member routes used for this fan-out. Mailbox B is excluded per recipient.

HelloCommand.description: First command: protocol version and capabilities. Answer: `ack.result` =  {@link  ChatDaemonHello } .

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing. Local bridge call only.

body.description: Decrypted plaintext body (the ChatMessage JSON string as the host stored it).

x-privacy.nodeSees: IPFS gateway: encrypted fragment + index. Beamio API relay and the chain: own wallet + new index hash (EIP-712 `SetPointer`).

peer.description: Contact EOA (lower) this batch belongs to, or 'all' when global.

isTail.description: True when this batch is the tail (most recent) portion.

HistoryBufferEvent.description: History buffer increment fed to the UI during restore / append.

body.description: Decrypted plaintext body (the ChatMessage JSON string as the host stored it).

x-privacy.nodeSees: CoNET RPC: `getPointer(ownEoa)` + IP. IPFS gateway: content hashes of AES-GCM fragments + IP. The key-derivation signatures stay on the device.

peer.description: Restore for a single contact, or all known contacts.

tailCount.description: How many most-recent entries to decrypt eagerly (the "last 2 screens"). Default 60.

localOnly.description: When true, skip network and only read the local IndexedDB mirror (instant open).

emit.description: `all` replays every decrypted entry to `historyBuffer`. `fresh` emits only entries that were not already in the local plaintext corpus. Default `fresh` so a later sync does not re-deliver the corpus.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing. Local corpus.

peer.description: Contact EOA. Omit to read every peer.

query.description: Full-text query over extracted message text (body, call status, file name). Whitespace-separated terms are AND-matched, case-insensitive.

limit.description: Keep the newest matches when set.

HistoryReadOptions.description: Read the chat module's local decrypted history. Already-decrypted entries come from the worker corpus and are not fetched from IPFS again.

line.description: Host-ready JSON envelope string — exactly what the app's `addNewMessage` serial queue consumes today (outer `{ timestamp, text, from, signMessage }` with `_beamioPgpArmorHash` attached for mailbox ACK). Host still runs `checkSign` + business parse on this on the main thread.

armorHash.description: keccak256 of the received PGP armor (matches SI saveLocal hash for delivery ACK).

plain.description: True when the inbound frame was a plaintext envelope (no PGP decrypt happened).

viaDomain.description: Node domain that forwarded this (diagnostic only).

InboundMessageEvent.description: Decrypted inbound line. TS Worker: still to be verified by the page. Native: already verified; `from` is the recovered signer (rule 15).

InitCommand.description: Start a session and the mailbox listen. Answer: `ready` (native: `result.historyApi = 2`).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Entry C: client IP + ciphertext with the own mailbox route key ID, then only sealed, 256-byte-aligned SSE frames (`streamKey` in the listen command; no recipient key ID, wallet or frame type). Own mailbox B: own wallet in the signed `mailbox_listen` (its own registered mailbox). History setup reads `getPointer(ownEoa)` from the CoNET RPC (RPC sees own wallet + IP).
Same as `sendGroup`; the owner-signed roster is inside each member's user-PGP layer.
Same as `sendGroup`.

LogEvent.description: Diagnostics. Never contains private keys, mnemonics, session keys or message content.

MailboxCommandCommand.description: Sign + encrypt a mailbox command to route B and POST via entry ≠ B. Only for the own mailbox or rule-21 queries.

x-privacy.nodeSees: The target mailbox decrypts the command and sees the wallet signature and every field. Entry ≠ that mailbox: client IP + ciphertext.
x-privacy.gap: Generic: signs with the own wallet. Use only for the own mailbox (e.g. `gossip_delivery_ack`) or rule-21 queries; never for a command a contact's mailbox executes (rules 20, 22).

message.description: eip191: the exact text to sign.

typedData.description: eip712: `{ domain, types, primaryType, message | value }`.

NativeSignRequest.description: Native daemon → page: sign with the page's wallet key. Sent only by daemons without `signing.local`, or with it but no stored key. The page answers with `chatModuleSignResponse { reqId, ok, signature?, error? }`.

NodeInfo.description: A CoNET Guardian / entry / mailbox node descriptor. Mirrors the app `nodeInfo`.

NodesRequestEvent.description: The daemon asks the host to refresh the node list (host owns discovery).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing. Local state.

OwnMailboxCommandCommand.description: Same as `mailboxCommand`, to the own mailbox route.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Own mailbox B: own wallet + the command (e.g. push registration). Entry C ≠ B: client IP + ciphertext.

PauseCommand.description: Page went to the background. With `lifecycle.daemon` the daemon may defer it (ringing / in call).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing (the listen closes).

online.description: Map of contact address(lower) → online. Only trusted `ok:true` replies included.

ProvisionIdentityCommand.description: Hand the keys to the daemon (capability `identity.provision`). Answer: `ack { ok }`.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing. The keys cross the in-process page → daemon bridge only; native stores them in Keychain / Keystore and never logs them.

eoa.description: Wallet address. The daemon refuses a `walletPrivateKey` that does not derive it.

walletPrivateKey.description: Raw wallet private key hex. Never logged. Native: Keychain / Keystore only; refused when it cannot be stored.

ownRoute.description: Own mailbox B route armored public key.

QueryNativeWakeCommand.description: Answer: `ack.result` = boolean | null (TS) or `{ ok, nativeWakeable }` (native).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Same as `queryPresence` (`wallet_native_wake_query`).
Contact mailbox: querier wallet (signed `wallet_online_query.walletAddress`) + target wallet. Entry C ≠ B: querier IP + ciphertext.
x-privacy.gap: Known exception (rule 21): the contact mailbox learns who asks. To be solved with web3://; do not patch ad hoc.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Same as the listen part of `init`.

payload.description: The pending-row JSON the wallet signs (`{ sendId, from: 'me', text, createdAt }`).

SendCommand.description: Business payload to one contact. Answer: `ack.result = { sent, sendId }`.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Entry (never the recipient's or the sender's own mailbox; one at a time): sender IP, its own route key ID (outer wrap), then the recipient mailbox route key ID (mailbox-work layer), never the recipient user key ID. Recipient mailbox: decrypts the mailbox-work layer `{ data: <user-PGP armor>, NoPush? }` and sees the recipient key ID. Sender wallet, signature and PGP key are only inside the user-PGP layer.
Per member, the same as `send`: one user-PGP armor per member (no multi-recipient armor, so no member list on the wire).
x-privacy.gap: Native daemons send a plain signed envelope per member, not group V1 (no `group.v1` capability).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Nothing. Local state.
Nothing. Local state.

uiKey.description: AES key the page uses for its own frames; the worker re-keys per channel.

avoidRoutes.description: Route keys (armored) of both mailboxes: never used as relay or entry.

VoiceCallV3Config.description: Everything the chat worker needs to run a v3 call. Memory only.

x-privacy.nodeSees: Peer channel relay: channel locator + MAC + opaque chunk (v3; no v1 fallback). Entry: rotating pool, never a relay or a mailbox.
x-privacy.gap: Native: delegated to the native voice module.

sessionId.description: Own voice channel of the call (v3). Without `call`: reopen that call's channels.

call.description: Voice protocol v3 call: own and peer channels (memory only).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Relay (picked by this side, never a mailbox): `voice_listen` v3 = session ID, write key, temporary wallet T and its signature, and the payer wallet's signature over T (payer address, `notAfter`). Nothing about the peer or the call ID.
x-privacy.gap: The relay learns the payer wallet (user decision 2026-11-01: payment proof by payer signature; clients may split payment across wallets). Native: delegated to the native voice module.

sessionId.description: Ring ID (32 hex): offer index and push handle, not a channel.

offerArmor.description: Callee user-PGP ciphertext of the signed offer.

VoiceOfferArgs.description: `voiceOffer`: the caller's offer to the callee mailbox (`voice_offer_store`, `push: 1`).

x-privacy.nodeSees: Callee mailbox: opaque `voice_offer_store` with `push: 1` (ring ID); it stores the offer, writes it to the callee's sessions and rings the callee. The caller signature is only inside the callee user-PGP `offerArmor`.

relay.description: Relay route key ID (node domain). Empty: the worker picks one.

VoiceOwnChannel.description: A channel this side opens (listens on).

relayKey.description: base64 armored route key of the relay (used when our node table lacks it).

VoicePeerChannel.description: A channel this side sends to. `relay` empty until the owner reports it.

x-privacy.nodeSees: The channel relay: unsigned `voice_unlisten` with the session ID.

WalletSignaturePath.description: Where the user's wallet signature travels.  - `none`: no wallet signature leaves the device.  - `recipientLayer`: only inside ciphertext for the recipient's user PGP (rule 22).  - `ownMailbox`: inside a route command only the user's own mailbox B decrypts.  - `peerMailbox`: inside a route command a contact's mailbox decrypts (rule 21 exception only).  - `apiRelay`: an EIP-712 signature sent to the Beamio API relay / chain.

apiBaseUrl.description: Cluster API base for the gasless index-pointer relay (optional).

sendFanout.description: Send business payload to N entry nodes in parallel (dedupe by sendId on UI). Default 3.

outerWrap.description: Encrypt already-built inner armor to each entry's route public key before `POST /post` (SI peel). Default `true`. One-layer user-PGP still works if false.

nodes.description: Initial node snapshot (the daemon requests refreshes via `nodesRequest`).

deferAck.description: Capability `inbound.deferAck`: hold the mailbox ACK and the sender receipt until the page confirms the message with `ackInbound`. Ignored by daemons without the capability (they ACK at once, or leave the ACK to the page).

WorkerInitPayload.description: Serialisable subset of config passed into the daemon at init.
